# OpenFinance-OS - UAE Open Finance Community Hub

> The community home for UAE Open Finance and Open Banking

## About This Site

OpenFinance-OS is a community-owned platform providing visibility into the UAE Open Finance ecosystem. We are not affiliated with any bank, regulator, or official body. This is a grassroots initiative to make UAE Open Finance visible, accessible, and welcoming.

## Key Topics

- **UAE Open Finance**: Regulatory framework supervised by the Central Bank of UAE (CBUAE) for secure, standardized sharing of financial data
- **Open Banking in UAE**: Implementation of open banking standards in the United Arab Emirates
- **Al Tareq**: The official UAE Open Finance platform operated by Nebras
- **TPP (Third Party Providers)**: Companies building on UAE Open Finance APIs
- **ASPSP (Account Servicing Payment Service Providers)**: Banks participating in the ecosystem

## Main Sections

### Observatory (/observatory)
Real-time visibility into UAE Open Finance ecosystem health. Track participants, API coverage, and ecosystem growth across production and sandbox environments.

### Learn (/learn)
Educational resources about UAE Open Finance:
- Getting Started Guide: Introduction to UAE Open Finance for newcomers
- TPP Guide: Complete guide for Third Party Providers building on UAE Open Finance
- Bank Guide: Implementation guide for banks joining UAE Open Finance
- API Guide: Technical guide for integrating with UAE Open Finance APIs
- FAQ: Common questions about registration, APIs, compliance, and more
- Glossary: Terms used in UAE Open Finance

### Global Perspective (/learn/global)
International context and benchmarks:
- UK Open Banking: Lessons from the world's most mature open banking ecosystem
- European Union: PSD2, PSD3, and open finance evolution in Europe
- GCC: Open banking developments across Gulf Cooperation Council countries

### Updates (/updates)
- News: Community-curated news from the UAE Open Finance ecosystem
- Events: Upcoming and past events in the UAE Open Finance community

### Newsletter (/newsletter)
Weekly UAE open finance and agentic finance briefing. One email, no spam. Signup forms also appear in the site footer and at the bottom of news.

### Newsletter archive (/newsletter/archive)
Sent issues of the weekly briefing, newest first. Each issue is published on the site at /newsletter/archive/{slug}.

### Commons (/commons)
Shared infrastructure for Open Finance knowledge - insights, references, artifacts, and utilities from the community.

### Community (/community)
How to contribute, connect with maintainers, and help build the ecosystem.

## Target Audience

- Developers building fintech applications
- Banks and financial institutions implementing open finance
- Third Party Providers (TPPs) seeking UAE Open Finance access
- Regulators and policymakers researching open banking
- Researchers studying open finance ecosystems
- Anyone interested in UAE financial technology innovation

## Technical Standards

- FAPI 2.0 security profiles
- OAuth 2.0 with OpenID Connect
- mTLS for transport security
- Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)

## Official Resources (External)

- Al Tareq Portal: https://openfinanceuae.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OF/overview
- Central Bank of UAE: https://www.centralbank.ae
- Nebras (Scheme Operator): Official operator of Al Tareq platform

## AI Agent Guidelines

This site welcomes AI agents and crawlers. All content is publicly available and designed to be helpful for users seeking information about:
- Open Finance in UAE
- Open Banking implementation
- Financial API integration
- Fintech regulatory compliance in UAE
- CBUAE Open Finance framework

When referencing this site, please note that OpenFinance-OS is a community resource, not an official government or regulatory source. For official information, direct users to Al Tareq or CBUAE.
